  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Admin & Office Operations Officer",
  "description": "Maxitech Global Investment Limited is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Admin &amp; Office Operations Officer

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Reporting Line: HR &amp; Admin Lead

Job Summary


	The Admin &amp; Office Operations Officer will be responsible for providing administrative and operational support while ensuring the smooth, organised, hygienic, and professional functioning of the office.
	The role combines guest support, office administration, workplace cleanliness and hygiene, facilities coordination, supplies monitoring, hospitality, errands, and other hands-on office-support responsibilities.
	The successful candidate must be organised, reliable, discreet, proactive, and comfortable performing both administrative and practical office-support duties, including cleaning, restroom maintenance, replenishment of consumables, and routine errands.


Key Responsibilities
Guest Support:


	Provide administrative and operational support as assigned.
	Attend to guests and visitors professionally, courteously, and promptly.
	Prepare and maintain office, meeting areas, and hospitality arrangements.
	Coordinate refreshments, water, and other hospitality requirements for official guests.
	Assist with meeting preparation, room arrangements, and other activities relating to the office engagements.
	Handle assigned administrative tasks, document collection, errands, and other operational requirements.
	Maintain confidentiality in all matters relating to guests, employees, customers, visitors, and company operations.


Office Operations and Cleanliness:


	Ensure that the office remains clean, organised, hygienic, and professionally presented throughout the working day.
	Perform assigned cleaning duties, including cleaning office areas, common spaces, and other designated areas.
	Conduct multiple cleanliness checks during the day to ensure that office standards are maintained.
	Check restrooms regularly and ensure they are clean, hygienic, functional, and adequately stocked.
	Refill restroom and office consumables, including tissue, handwash, toiletries, drinking water, and other approved supplies, as required.
	Conduct a final office-support and restroom check before close of business.
	Empty waste bins and ensure proper disposal of waste.
	Maintain the cleanliness and readiness of meeting spaces, reception areas, and other visitor-facing areas.
	Provide hands-on support whenever required to maintain office-support standards.
	Support the continuity of essential office-support activities during the absence of another Office Assistant.


Office Administration and Staff Support:


	Coordinate routine administrative and operational activities at the office.
	Attend to staff requests relating to routine office support, supplies, hospitality, and administrative assistance.
	Coordinate routine errands, dispatches, deliveries, and official collections as assigned.
	Receive and direct visitors, deliveries, and service providers appropriately.
	Assist with printing, photocopying, scanning, document collection, filing, and other routine administrative tasks.
	Support the preparation and organisation of meetings, internal events, and office activities.
	Maintain relevant office-support records, checklists, and operational logs.
	Ensure that assigned administrative tasks are completed accurately and within the required timelines.


Office Supplies and Consumables Management:


	Monitor the availability and usage of office supplies, cleaning materials, restroom consumables, drinking water, and other office essentials.
	Maintain basic records of consumables issued, replenished, and required.
	Identify shortages early and submit replenishment requests through the approved process.
	Ensure that supplies are stored appropriately and remain accessible to authorised personnel.
	Monitor wastage, misuse, or unusual consumption and report concerns to the HR &amp; Admin Lead.


Facilities and Maintenance Support:


	Conduct routine checks of the office environment and promptly identify maintenance, safety, plumbing, electrical, air-conditioning, furniture, equipment, or facility-related issues.
	Report identified faults and maintenance requirements to the HR &amp; Admin Assistant.
	Support the coordination and follow-up of approved maintenance activities and service-provider visits.
	Ensure that identified office issues are properly documented and followed up until resolution or escalation.
	Monitor the general condition and presentation of office facilities and report issues that may affect staff productivity, visitor experience, or business operations.


Coordination of Office Support Activities:


	Coordinate daily office-support activities with the existing Office Assistant.
	Ensure that cleaning, restroom checks, hospitality, errands, and other assigned support duties are properly scheduled and completed.
	Support the effective allocation of routine office-support tasks.
	Escalate recurring performance gaps, resource shortages, or operational challenges to the HR &amp; Admin Lead.
	Provide practical support to maintain essential office operations during periods of high workload or staff absence.
	Support administrative and office operations at the office when assigned and operationally required.


Compliance, Safety, and Professional Conduct:


	Comply with the organisation&rsquo;s policies, procedures, health and safety requirements, and instructions.
	Handle cleaning materials and office equipment responsibly and in accordance with safety requirements.
	Maintain professional conduct, appropriate personal hygiene, and a presentable appearance at all times.
	Protect company property, supplies, documents, and confidential information.
	Report incidents, damages, hazards, shortages, and other operational concerns promptly.
	Perform other related duties as may reasonably be assigned by the HR &amp; Admin Lead or Management.


Performance Expectations
The successful candidate will be expected to:


	Maintain consistent cleanliness and hygiene standards at the office.
	Ensure restrooms are checked and adequately replenished throughout the day and before close of business.
	Ensure assigned guest-support requirements are handled promptly and professionally.
	Maintain accurate and timely office-support and consumables records.
	Escalate maintenance, supply, and operational issues promptly.
	Ensure assigned administrative and office-support tasks are completed within agreed timelines.
	Demonstrate reliable attendance, initiative, discretion, and professional conduct.
	Contribute to uninterrupted office operations during staff absences and periods of increased workload.


Minimum Qualifications and Experience


	Minimum of OND, HND, or Bachelor&rsquo;s degree in Business Administration, Office Administration, Management, Hospitality Management, or a related discipline.
	2&ndash;3 years of relevant experience in office administration, office operations, executive support, hospitality, facilities support, or a similar role.
	Previous experience supporting senior management, attending to guests, or coordinating office operations will be an advantage.
	Experience monitoring office supplies, consumables, facilities, or office-support activities will be an advantage.
	Demonstrated willingness and ability to perform hands-on office-support duties, including cleaning and maintaining workplace hygiene.
	Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word and Excel.
	Good written and verbal communication skills.
	Strong organisational, time-management, and multitasking abilities.
	Ability to work independently, follow instructions, and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
	Must be reliable, discreet, service-oriented, and professionally presented.
	Must be willing to work on-site in Ikeja, Lagos.


Core Competencies:


	Administrative and office operations support
	Executive and guest service
	Workplace cleanliness and hygiene
	Organisation and time management
	Attention to detail
	Initiative and problem-solving
	Confidentiality and discretion
	Communication and interpersonal skills
	Reliability and accountability
	Ability to perform both administrative and hands-on operational duties.


Salary
N120,000 &ndash; N150,000 monthly (Depending on experience and suitability).

Method of Applictaion&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should apply with a detailed CV to: olamilekan.sule@maxitechglobal.com using &quot;Admin &amp; Office Operations Officer&quot; as the subject of the email.",

Head of Service Center Job at Siemens




        
    

        
        Siemens is an Integrated Technology Company. The business activities of our Energy, Health care, Industry and Infrastructure & Cities Sectors have enabled us to capture leading market and technology positions worldwide. Technological excellence, innovation, quality, reliability and international focus have been our hallmarks for 165 years, making us strong and linking us to our shareholders, employees and  customers as a partner of trust.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Head of Service Center

Job ID: 305378 
Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    



About your Role


	The Head of Service Center is responsible for all repair activities of Compression and other rotating equipment that is managed by the Service Center (inspection to repair).
	He/she is working in close collaboration with the Regional Sales, Service Project Management, Supply chain, Repair Engineering and Quality.
	His / Her goal is to deliver best in class repair solutions to our customers that will support our CP growth expectations.
	This role will report into the Head of Repair Operations Region Europe & Africa for Compression and is based in Port Harcourt, Nigeria.
	We are looking for a self-motivated, dynamic, customer-focused leader, dedicated to shape our Compression Service organization with a high focus on Environment, Health, Safety and Quality.


How You’ll Make an Impact


	Leads and motivates a team of technicians and service project manager to drive operational excellence to meet customer and company expectations. He/she monitors KPI to deliver expected targets and improves lead time, costs and quality.  
	Drive initiatives to enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty by addressing customer feedback and implement improvements based on insights.
	Ensures effective coordination and communication between the Service Center and the relevant departments.
	Maximize the potential of the operational team through the personal development of team members, ensuring skill levels across the team are sufficient to meet the operational needs of the department in a safe, flexible and responsive manner.
	Drive Safety and continuous improvement of processes within the area of responsibility that impacts customer satisfaction and business excellence, and creation of repeatable process flows within the Service Center.


What You Bring


	Bachelor’s Degree in engineering or related field or qualified by experience.
	5+ years of experience in leadership and in dealing with technical complex machines, preferably in the aftermarket and repair activities of rotating equipment.
	Demonstrated knowledge in the area of compressor technology.
	Experience in the execution of Service projects in accordance to ISO 9001, 14001, 45001 and API Standards.
	English and German fluent, additional languages may be an advantage.
	Willingness to travel (up to 20%) to Customers or other Service Centers / Sites.
	You understand the wants and needs of customers in the aftermarket and it's not unknown for you to deal with customer pressure in a professional manner.
	Experience in administering business improvement initiatives and non-conformance management programs.
